name: Chicken & Bell Pepper Fajitas with Guacamole & Butter Lettuce

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry bell peppers. Seed, slice into thin strips, and transfer to a bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
3 yellow bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Peel, thinly slice into half rings, and add onion to bowl with peppers. Peel and mince garlic; add ½ to bowl with vegetables and place the other ½ into a medium bowl for preparing guacamole.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onion
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Halve avocados and remove pit; scoop out the flesh into bowl with garlic.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add ½ to bowl with avocado and save the rest for garnishing.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets, then thinly slice fillets crosswise into strips. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.681 chicken breasts, boneless skinless
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken strips and cook until no longer pink, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Add lime juice, salt, and pepper to avocado. Mash with a fork until smooth. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
juice of 1 ½ limes
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: After chicken has been transferred add more oil to skillet. Add peppers, onion, and garlic from bowl. Stirring frequently, cook until peppers are tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes.
Return chicken and any juices to skillet. Season with chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine and cook for 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp cumin
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, fill lettuce leaves with fajita mix. Garnish with guacamole, remaining cilantro, and lime wedges. Enjoy!
